materials.name: Wood
materials.description: I learned to work with wood at HMC Amsterdam and quickly got comfortable with it.

materials.name: Plastic
materials.description: I bought my first 3D printer years ago as hobby which quickly led to 3D modelling become a sketch tool for me. This led me to currently print comfortably with different materials to create molds, jigs, mechanical parts or prototypes.

materials.name: Metal
materials.description: I learned translating my previous Origami interest in to metal in the metal workshop at the Design Academy Eindhoven. It quickly became one of my more used material; from bending to grinding to currently learning how to weld.

materials.name: Stone
materials.description:
I bought a small kiln for my SO to experiment with. Which in the end came to be a gift for myself too.
Concrete is everywhere and thus sparked my interest to learn and someday master.

materials.name: Textile
materials.description:
My grandma's gave me their sewing machines. But two wasn't enough. 
I quickly learned that next to woven sheets and fashion the machines themselves also interest me and thus led me to own 6 different ones with a preference to old work horses.
